title: Spain: Regions
description: Spain broken down by NUTS2 region: unemployment rate, GDP per capita and population, via Eurostat.

panels.title: Spain: all NUTS2 regions, latest values
panels.description: One row per NUTS2 region (Eurostat's statistical region level, roughly analogous to a US state or a large Dutch province). Unemployment: lfst_r_lfu3rt. GDP per capita: nama_10r_2gdp. Population: demo_r_pjangrp3.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT CASE right(indicator, 4) WHEN 'ES11' THEN 'Galicia' WHEN 'ES12' THEN 'Principado de Asturias' WHEN 'ES13' THEN 'Cantabria' WHEN 'ES21' THEN 'País Vasco' WHEN 'ES22' THEN 'Comunidad Foral de Navarra' WHEN 'ES23' THEN 'La Rioja' WHEN 'ES24' THEN 'Aragón' WHEN 'ES30' THEN 'Comunidad de Madrid' WHEN 'ES41' THEN 'Castilla y León' WHEN 'ES42' THEN 'Castilla-La Mancha' WHEN 'ES43' THEN 'Extremadura' WHEN 'ES51' THEN 'Cataluña' WHEN 'ES52' THEN 'Comunitat Valenciana' WHEN 'ES53' THEN 'Illes Balears' WHEN 'ES61' THEN 'Andalucía' WHEN 'ES62' THEN 'Región de Murcia' WHEN 'ES63' THEN 'Ciudad de Ceuta' WHEN 'ES64' THEN 'Ciudad de Melilla' WHEN 'ES70' THEN 'Canarias' ELSE right(indicator, 4) END AS "Region",
           MAX(CASE WHEN indicator LIKE 'regional_unemployment_pct_%' THEN value END) AS "Unemployment %",
           MAX(CASE WHEN indicator LIKE 'regional_gdp_per_capita_eur_%' THEN value END) AS "GDP per capita (EUR)",
           MAX(CASE WHEN indicator LIKE 'regional_population_%' THEN value END) AS "Population"
    FROM (
        SELECT DISTINCT ON (indicator) indicator, value
        FROM price_index
        WHERE country_iso3='ESP' AND source='eurostat'
          AND (indicator LIKE 'regional_unemployment_pct_ES%'
               OR indicator LIKE 'regional_gdp_per_capita_eur_ES%'
               OR indicator LIKE 'regional_population_ES%')
        ORDER BY indicator, period_date DESC
    ) latest
    GROUP BY 1
    ORDER BY "GDP per capita (EUR)" DESC NULLS LAST

panels.title: Spain: unemployment rate by region, ranked

targets.rawSql:
SELECT CASE right(indicator, 4) WHEN 'ES11' THEN 'Galicia' WHEN 'ES12' THEN 'Principado de Asturias' WHEN 'ES13' THEN 'Cantabria' WHEN 'ES21' THEN 'País Vasco' WHEN 'ES22' THEN 'Comunidad Foral de Navarra' WHEN 'ES23' THEN 'La Rioja' WHEN 'ES24' THEN 'Aragón' WHEN 'ES30' THEN 'Comunidad de Madrid' WHEN 'ES41' THEN 'Castilla y León' WHEN 'ES42' THEN 'Castilla-La Mancha' WHEN 'ES43' THEN 'Extremadura' WHEN 'ES51' THEN 'Cataluña' WHEN 'ES52' THEN 'Comunitat Valenciana' WHEN 'ES53' THEN 'Illes Balears' WHEN 'ES61' THEN 'Andalucía' WHEN 'ES62' THEN 'Región de Murcia' WHEN 'ES63' THEN 'Ciudad de Ceuta' WHEN 'ES64' THEN 'Ciudad de Melilla' WHEN 'ES70' THEN 'Canarias' ELSE right(indicator, 4) END AS "Region", value AS "Unemployment %"
    FROM (
        SELECT DISTINCT ON (indicator) indicator, value
        FROM price_index
        WHERE country_iso3='ESP' AND source='eurostat'
          AND indicator LIKE 'regional_unemployment_pct_ES%'
        ORDER BY indicator, period_date DESC
    ) latest
    ORDER BY value DESC
